artworks.title: Walter Sickert
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person seated in a relaxed posture. The person appears to be leaning against a chair's backrest, with their hands resting in their lap. The facial features are softly rendered, with a focus on the eyes and a slightly tilted head. The hair is depicted as slightly wavy and brushed back from the forehead. The person is dressed in formal attire, featuring a coat, possibly a vest, a collared shirt, and a tie. The shading suggests textured garments. The surroundings are sparse, with cross-hatched shading creating a backdrop. There are no specific jewelry or objects in the image. The background consists of textured shading that adds depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Mother and Child, No. 1
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting and holding a child on her lap. Both the woman and child are depicted with most of their bodies visible. The woman's face is gently sketched, looking down at the child. She has styled hair and is wearing a flowing garment. The child appears unclothed with curly hair. The background is lightly sketched, possibly suggesting an indoor setting with basic furnishings.

artworks.title: Girl with Bowl
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person standing upright, facing slightly to the left in profile. The person's facial features are minimally detailed, and their hair is tied back. They are draped in flowing garments that cover their feet, and are holding a circular object in their right hand against their chest. The background is plain and light.

artworks.title: The Little Doorway, Lyme Regis
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a house facade with people at the entrance. The sketch depicts a building with a simple architectural design. A doorway is centered, flanked by windows. Surrounding the entrance are rectangular windows and few architectural lines. More windows are visible on the right. The lines are loose and impressionistic, focusing on conveying a sense of place. Shading adds subtle depth to the composition.

artworks.title: The Master Smith
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a sketch of a person seated in a three-quarter view. The person's body is turned slightly to the side, but their face is facing the viewer. The facial features are lightly detailed with a soft outline hinting at a slight smile. The person's hair is pulled back, possibly under a cap. The clothing is loosely depicted with broad strokes indicating a textured top and long sleeves. The figure is holding a glass in one hand. The background is lightly shaded around the person's head, while the rest of the paper is blank, highlighting the simplicity and focus on the figure.

artworks.title: The Sunny Smithy
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The pencil sketch shows three figures in a loose and impressionistic style. The central figure is bent over, with rough facial features and hair, wearing a long garment. Surrounding tools or equipment, possibly an anvil, suggest an industrial setting. Another figure is shown to the left, with fewer details, standing upright with an object near their waist. The background features blurred impressions of surrounding objects, conveying a sense of clutter.

artworks.title: The Good Shoe
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of horses and a person in a shaded area. The drawing depicts two horses standing with their backs facing the viewer under a canopy. Between the horses, a human figure is faintly shown. The drawing is minimalist, using light pencil strokes. At the bottom, there are a few scribbles adding texture.

artworks.title: Father and Son
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an industrial or work scene. The image shows two figures engaged in manual labor, likely around machinery. The drawing is made with loose lines using charcoal or graphite on paper. The background and details are suggested rather than explicitly drawn. The focus is on capturing the movement and posture of the figures. The overall atmosphere is one of active engagement within an industrial context.

artworks.title: The Smith's Yard
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stable with horses. The image shows a rustic stable with two horses near the entrance. One horse is partially turned towards the viewer, while the other is facing inward. The scene is depicted in soft pencil or charcoal strokes. Inside the stable, there is a darkened interior contrasting with the lighter exterior. Other elements like barrels or small objects can be seen, outlining the daily life and work in the stable. The drawing communicates a sense of peaceful rustic life through its attention to detail and shading.

artworks.title: The Strong Arm
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of two people with partial body visibility. One person is seated and facing slightly away from the viewer, while the other is seated at an angle relative to the viewer. Facial features are minimally detailed with simple lines indicating eyes, nose, and mouth, and both have short hair. The individuals are drawn with loose, sketchy lines suggesting clothing. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background includes shading and sketch lines, creating an abstract setting without clear contextual elements.

artworks.title: The Blacksmith
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketched illustration of a man shown from the waist up. He is facing forward with a slight tilt to his posture, and one arm appears to be resting on something in front of him. The man's facial features are faintly detailed; he seems to have a mustache and his head is turned to the side. His hair is short and dark. He is wearing a long-sleeved shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows. The background shows various objects and structures, like the large wheel of a cart in the foreground and some indistinct forms suggestive of pottery or jars.

artworks.title: The Brothers
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a black and white sketch showing two people with upper bodies and part of their arms visible. Both individuals are seated or positioned in a relaxed manner. The person on the left is slightly leaning back and the person on the right is facing forward. The facial features are indistinct, drawn in a sketchy style, with both individuals having short hair. The person on the left appears to have facial hair, while the person on the right has clean features. They are dressed in loose-fitting clothes that appear to be shirts. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by them. The background is primarily dark, with light scribblings suggesting a textured wall or shaded environment, and there are abstract forms that may suggest trees or patterns above them.

artworks.title: The Fair
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene with buildings, market stalls, and people. The drawing uses black and gray tones with loose lines to depict an outdoor market or street scene. Market stalls can be seen on either side with various forms suggesting the presence of goods. The central area is filled with the abstract suggestion of a crowd of people engaged in activities. Shadows and textured lines create depth and movement, giving the composition a lively atmosphere. The style hints at an impressionistic approach, focusing on the feel of a busy urban setting rather than specific details.

artworks.title: John Grove
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man from the upper body down to his lower chest. He has his hands near his lap, and his head is slightly tilted to one side. The man has distinct facial features, a full beard and mustache. He is wearing a hat covering his long, wavy hair. His clothing consists of a suit with a shirt underneath, depicted loosely. The background is mostly blank, with light sketch lines indicating some texture. To the right of his head, there is writing that reads "John Grove. the Royal London."

artworks.title: The Little Steps, Lyme Regis
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two people next to a doorway. One person stands at the entrance, facing slightly to the side. Their features are sketched with minimal strokes, with indistinct facial features and hair details. They appear to be wearing a dress or long garment. Another person stands inside the doorway, partly obscured by the doorframe. Their upper body is visible with darkened shading indicating their form and clothing. The facade of a building with windows and architectural details, including a bay window, is shown behind them. The sketch features simple lines with no intricate details or embellishments. The background is plain, focusing on the building and figures.

artworks.title: Study of a Horse
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse. The drawing shows a horse standing with its rear towards the viewer, sketched in a minimalistic style. The background consists of light shading and a few horizontal and vertical lines, suggesting a simplistic setting or possibly an enclosure. The illustration emphasizes the horse's form and the play of light and shadow on its body, using delicate pencil strokes to convey texture and depth. The drawing captures a sense of quiet and solitude with its sparse composition.

artworks.title: Sunday, Lyme Regis
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a busy street captured in a sketchy, impressionistic style with loose brushstrokes. The scene is depicted from a slightly elevated perspective, showing buildings lining the street with a few indicated windows and architectural details. A larger structure is seen on the right side. In the foreground, a dog looks towards a group of figures on horseback. The street is filled with small, loosely sketched figures indicating movement and activity. The sky above is lightly textured with a few clouds. The image is rendered in black and white, creating a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Fifth of November
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a monochrome sketch of figures in a vague outdoor scene. The figures are minimally detailed and appear to be interacting in an undefined space. The background is filled with soft lines suggesting movement or texture.

artworks.title: The Old Smith's Story
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures depicted from the waist up. The figure on the left is seated, facing slightly towards the viewer with a relaxed posture. The figure on the right is standing or leaning, facing the side with a more detailed profile. They appear to be wearing a long-sleeved shirt tucked into pants. The background is an abstract blur of strokes, suggesting an indoor setting. The sketch is done with expressive lines.

artworks.title: Red House, Paimpol
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historic half-timbered building. The structure depicted in the drawing is characterized by its timber framing and intricate patterns. The building features multiple stories with visible half-timber structures, and the roof is steep. The drawing is minimalistic, with hints of red to highlight architectural details. The sketch is rendered on a beige background with varying line density suggesting depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Yellow House, Lannion
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a linear view of a building with a steep roof, depicted from a straight-on perspective. The composition focuses on the house's façade, with rough outlines and textures suggesting quick brushstrokes. The roof features earthy browns and cool grays with detailed shingle-like textures. A small dormer window and green shutters adorn the house. Two small figures are at the forefront. The scene includes an arched entryway and open windows, with a soft color palette of yellows, greens, grays, and browns against a light tan background.

artworks.title: Mother and Child, No. 2
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the sketch of a woman seated with her entire body visible. She is depicted sitting on a surface and leaning slightly forward with her face turned to the left. The sketch shows the woman with soft facial features and curly or wavy hair, covered by a wrap or hat. She is wearing a flowing garment, and her arms are wrapped around her knees. The sketch is done in a loose and expressive style with minimal detailing. The background is simple, suggesting a wall or the back of furniture.

artworks.title: Firelight
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a charcoal or pencil sketch of a person, only showing the upper half of their body. The person is sitting at a slight angle, facing forward. Their facial features are softly rendered, with a focus on the eyes and mouth. Their hair is voluminous and styled loosely. The person is wearing a high-collared garment with minimal detailing. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is depicted with broad, rough strokes for texture.

artworks.title: Firelight: Joseph Pennell, No. 1
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a figure seated in an armchair. The person is in a relaxed position, with legs crossed and one hand resting on their cheek. The sketch does not show detailed facial features, but suggests short hair. The figure is wearing loose-fitting clothing. The background is filled with cross-hatched lines.
